methodology.gross: For reported spread groups, gross long = long + spreading and gross short = short + spreading. Missing spread buckets are not invented.
methodology.weeklyFlow: 100 × change in net / previous snapshot OI; requires a comparable 6–8 day snapshot interval.
methodology.persistence: Two/four-week net difference divided by starting OI, not a sum of weekly percentages.
methodology.percentile: Prior-only empirical midrank over exactly 52 or 156 observations. Current snapshot excluded; insufficient history remains unavailable.
methodology.bias: Managed-money weekly net change and gross-side decomposition provide a qualitative positioning backdrop. Other categories are counterparts, not independent directional votes.
methodology.publication: Tuesday positions are not backdated as available. Publication-date references and schedules are recorded separately; strict availability uses the retrieved revision vintage timestamp.
methodology.vintage: Official historical files reflect the retrieved revision vintage, not a complete archive of reports as first published.
methodology.priceProbabilities: Not estimated. COT context is not a validated return or range probability.

GC.scope: Futures only · all GC 100 oz report maturities

publication.note: Observed available at 2026-11-01T09:08:35.595200+00:00. 2026-10-30 is the scheduled release date; the actual timestamp is unverified.

notes: 252 official CFTC Gold 100 oz snapshots from 2022-01-04 through 2026-10-27; source archives checked 2026-11-01.
CFTC 088691 contains 100 troy-ounce Gold contracts across report maturities. Micro Gold 088695 is a separate report and has not been added.
Producer/merchant and nonreportable spreading are not separately reported. Swap, managed-money and other-reportable spreads are included in gross exposure and OI reconciliation.
Every historical long and short total reconciles exactly to open interest; all category net positions sum to zero.
Changes are recomputed from successive snapshots of outstanding positions. They are not executed orders, cash inflow or verified trader intent.
Empirical ranks use only the preceding 52 or 156 observations and exclude the current snapshot. A positioning percentile is not a future price probability.
This is a saved official snapshot, not a streaming feed. Snapshot date and publication time are distinct.

The 2026 calendar supplies scheduled publication dates, not independently archived actual timestamps. Delayed 2025 backlog publication dates are preserved from the latest official revised announcement.

The downloaded historical files are a revised-data vintage. A strict as-of query uses the retrieval timestamp for every row; historical publication dates do not prove this exact revision was then available.
No Tuesday price anchor, next-week range probability, arbitrary conviction score or P&L backtest is inferred from COT alone.

participants.mechanism: Gross long reductions and short additions reduced net exposure.

bias.label: Managed money strengthened

evidence: Still net long: 105,562 contracts (26.60% of OI).

limitations: A positioning reading, not a validated next-week price forecast or trading probability.
